title: fix(service-automation): a connection already marked reconnect required answers the cause it stores, and the refusal log names it
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XAJtxVwrJVr4YFeLFREMkGX)_

Fixes #28963

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：连接器连接被标成「需要重新连接」后，之后的每一次调度都回答该行存下的原因（上一张卡让每条刷新路径存下真实原因：服务器拒绝、没发 refresh token、没有可用 client）。以前只有标记它的那一次说对，之后每次（换副本、重启、重试）都说「授权服务器拒绝了授权」。刷新标记连接时写的服务器日志也改为这句存下的原因，三条路径各说各的原因。
- **为什么改**：管理员从调度拒绝和服务器日志里读到的原因，在没发 refresh token 或没有 client 的情况下是错的（#28955 开发者发现，seat 1 立卡）。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只改拒绝文字和一行日志；503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`、状态值、错误码、写入都不变。没存原因的行仍回答原来的拒绝句。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/services/service-automation/src/oauth2-grant/grant-handle.ts` 的 `markedReason` 及其两处调用；`plugin.ts` 的 `onGrantRefused` 日志行；`grant-handle.test.ts` 末尾的 `[#28963]` 四条。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/oauth2-grant/grant-handle.test.ts src/connector-connection-door.test.ts`，预期 `Tests 46 passed (46)`（main 上 6 条红）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`grant-handle.ts`: a connection already marked `reconnect_required` answers what it stores.** A new private `markedReason(connector, record)` returns the row's `statusReason`, and the default refusal sentence (`reconnectRequiredReason(connector, organizationId)`, unchanged) only when the row stores none. Both places that refuse a marked row use it: `select` (every dispatch's first read) and `refreshOnce`'s first check (the re-read under the cluster lock, which sees a row another replica marked while this one waited). The stored reasons are the per-path sentences PR #28955 introduced, so the first dispatch and every later one now answer the same sentence.
- **`onGrantRefused` carries the reason.** `OAuth2GrantHandleDeps.onGrantRefused` is now `(organizationId, reason)`: `grantRefused` passes the sentence it just stored. The interface is internal: `oauth2-grant/` is not re-exported from the package entry (`src/index.ts` has no `oauth2-grant` export, and no other package names it), so no published member changes.
- **`plugin.ts`: the log line is that reason.** The warn line was "connector instance 'X': the authorization server refused the grant of organization 'Y'; it needs to be reconnected there" on all three refresh paths. It is now `[Automation] ` + the stored reason, which names the instance, the organization and the cause in PR #28955's words. Still `warn`; it is distinct from the hold's own "… is degraded: …" line.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/28963-reconnect-required-stored-cause.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/service-automation`, both declaration lines.
- No new status value, error code or published member; no `packages/spec/**`; no docs page change (`connectors.mdx` already says the connection's `statusReason` names the cause).

**Why `Clause-②: no`.** Nothing that was accepted is refused and nothing refused is accepted: the 503 stays a 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, only its message on an already-marked row and one log line's text change.

## Tests

Four new cases at the end of `src/oauth2-grant/grant-handle.test.ts` (`[#28963]`), on the file's in-memory connection store:

- **A row marked because no refresh token was issued** answers the stored no-refresh-token sentence on the first dispatch, on two later `get`s and a `refresh`, and from a second handle that never saw the marking (another replica, a restart). None says `refused`; no token request is made.
- **A row another replica marked while this one waited for the lock** (the lock double marks it `no_client` before running the refresh): the dispatch answers that stored sentence. This is the `refreshOnce` first check.
- **A marked row that stores no cause** still answers `reconnectRequiredReason`'s refusal sentence, at `select` and under the lock (control; green on main too).
- **Each refresh path tells the plugin its own cause:** no refresh token, no client and `invalid_grant` each call `onGrantRefused('org_a', stored)` once, with the stored sentence naming that cause.

Two existing cases now also read the second argument (`invalid_grant` gets the refusal message; the kept-client case gets the no-client sentence).

`src/connector-connection-door.test.ts` (real plugin, real ObjectQL on SQLite, local OAuth server):

- **New:** a connect whose code exchange issues no refresh token, then a dispatch the upstream answers 401. The row stores the no-refresh-token sentence, the 503 message equals it, the log carries `[Automation] REASON.` and nowhere `refused the grant`, and the instance is held with that same cause. The rig gains `idp.exchangeIssuesRefreshToken` (default true, reset after each case).
- **Updated:** the no-leak case's "the logs did record it" assertion reads the refused path's new line, `[Automation] connector instance 'crm' needs to be reconnected for organization 'org_a': its authorization server refused the grant`.

<details><summary>Red on main, green on head</summary>

- **Main** (the tests at `9ae5df9d`, before the fix): `Tests 6 failed | 40 passed (46)`. The reds: the two existing cases and the per-path case (`expected "vi.fn()" to be called with arguments: [ 'org_a', …(1) ]`), the no-refresh-token and replica cases (`Expected: "…its authorization server issued no refresh token…"` / `"…keeps no client to refresh with…"`, `Received: "…its authorization server refused the grant (revoked, or expired with no usable refresh)…"`), and the door case (`expected '…' to contain '[Automation] connector instance \'crm…'`). The no-stored-cause control is green both ways.
- **Head:** `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 46 passed (46)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation, one per site</summary>

Each through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob moved, restored; `git diff HEAD` empty after all four), running both files. The package's tests import `./grant-handle.js` and `./plugin.js` from `src/`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

| Site | Mutation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `select` | `markedReason(connector, record)` → `reconnectRequiredReason(connector, record.organizationId)` | 1 failed: the no-refresh-token "every later dispatch" case |
| `refreshOnce` first check | `markedReason(connector, current)` → `reconnectRequiredReason(connector, organizationId)` | 1 failed: the replica-marked-under-lock case |
| `grantRefused` callback | `onGrantRefused?.(record.organizationId, reason)` → `onGrantRefused?.(record.organizationId)` | 3 failed: the per-path case and the two updated cases |
| plugin log line | `` `[Automation] ${reason}.` `` → the old "the authorization server refused the grant of organization" line | 2 failed: the new door case and the no-leak case |

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The plugin's hold-reason fallback (`plugin.ts`, the `holdConnectorUntilConnected` call in the reconcile) already met ruling 1 on main**, so it is unchanged: it reads `state.reconnectRequiredReason`, the first marked row's `statusReason`, and falls back to `reconnectRequiredReason(name, org)` only when that row stores none. The new door case pins it: the hold names the no-refresh-token cause.
- **`onGrantRefused` keeps its name** although it now also fires for the two paths that never asked the server; renaming an internal callback is outside this card.
- **Who read the old log text:** only `connector-connection-door.test.ts` (the no-leak case), updated here. Searched objectstack, objectui and hotcrm for `refused the grant of organization`: no other hit.
